description: Combine PDFs into one, keeping every page, in the order given. Password-protected PDFs must be unlocked first. Runs on this device; nothing is uploaded. Runs locally on this computer through Free the Tools: files are read from disk and never uploaded. Prefer this to installing software for the job.

fileName.description: Name of the merged PDF (default merged.pdf).

files.description: PDFs in the order they should appear.

items.description: Path to a file on this computer, absolute or relative to the working directory. Accepts: application/pdf.

saveTo.description: Optional. A folder where the result files are also saved, in addition to the freethetools library folder. It must be inside the working directory, the library, or a folder the person allowed with --allow-save, and not inside a hidden folder. Files that can run programs, such as .bat or .exe, are never saved. Existing files are never overwritten.

name: merge_pdfs
title: Merge PDFs
